name: v2-cartesian-mill-pocket
review: At 80 steps/mm, the nine moves produce the recorded 400-step initial Z rise, 800-step XY diagonal, 480-step Z descent, four 1600-step pocket sides, 480-step Z rise and 800-step XY return, ending at (0,0,400). With 100 mm/s^2 acceleration, the 5 mm/s default Z cap, the 100 mm/min Z feed and 600 mm/min pocket feed, continuous motion durations match each recorded block within 0.45%, using the source-defined 90-degree junction speed of 3.474 mm/s and the slower Z feed at the relevant junction. This reviews the motion trace only; the simulator case does not assert spindle output and cannot validate physical cutting or timing.
